texts.about_this_item: Kaskad Classic dog collar with a decorative woven braid, made of genuine high-quality leather with strong metal fittings. Width 30 mm, fits a neck girth of 49–58 cm. Features a steel D-ring, 4 adjustment holes and a metal buckle. Leather black or brown; braid pattern varies. Made in Russia.
